label: Twizted

won.source: Won the vacant title in the closing Ten-Man Steel Cage Match at Shadowed Light: From Dusk Till Dawn.

how: First man out of the cage; lost the title eleven days later to Josh Cagle at Hardcore Thursday.
note: The title had sat vacant since Tommy Richards' own retirement as champion at the end of 2000; no document surviving from that era narrates the vacancy in full.

note: Recorded from the promotion's own billing; no title-change document survives in the held record.

won.source: Beat Twizted with the Cold Spiral in an impromptu title match at Hardcore Thursday 3/1/2K1.

note: The promotion's own latest held document from this era; no later title change is recorded.

title: pfw-professional-fantasy-1997-world
label: Freddy Allocca

won.source: The promotion's own recruitment flyer, 23 January 1999, naming him the currently held World Champion.

note: Recorded from the promotion's own billing; no title-change document survives from that era. A later 2001 document shows the title vacant and re-won by Tommy Richards at an undated "Millennium Tournament" by the end of 2000, so this reign did not in fact run to the end of the surviving record; no document narrates how or when it ended.
